subject: general
question: Which of the following characterizes the diligence characteristic of a Computer?

options.text: Being able to work for hours without fatigue or lethargy
Ability to do multiple things at once
Being able to store huge amounts of data

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**** ****Diligence:** 

 
• The capacity of computer of performing repetitive task without getting tired is called diligence.
 
• A computer is free from tiredness, lack of concentration, fatigue etc therefore it can work for hours without creating any errors.
 
• A computer can perform millions of tasks or calculations with the same consistency and accuracy.
 
• It doesn’t feel any fatigue or lack of concentration.
 
• Its memory also makes it superior to that of human beings.

***Hence, being able to work for hours without fatigue or lethargy is the diligence characteristic of a Computer.***
